summary: Tamil Nadu official land-record, TNGIS, Sivakasi municipal and DILRMP evidence establishes local cadastral-service custody and digitization status, but bounded anonymous requests did not produce a parcel ID-plus-geometry response. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Tamil first-party queries, actual URLs and outcomes are recorded in city-10245-sivakasi.json.
requestOutcomes: The official land-record and map endpoints were attempted with TLS verification. The land-record and TNGIS hosts timed out, the DILRMP host was not retried after an untrusted certificate-chain failure, the municipal host timed out, and the India services host reset the connection. Indexed first-party content confirms the services and Sivakasi tehsil digitization record, but no safe parcel feature was retrieved.
attemptedRoutes: Tamil Nadu e-Services of Land Records
TNGIS current public map editor / Land Ownership UI
DILRMP Sivakasi tehsil village-level map-digitization record
National Portal of India Tamil Nadu land-record service page
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [9.45546113293646, 77.7983530925445] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted.

No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source attribute schema or authoritative CRS was retrieved or retained.

No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only; serial reviewer qualification and runtime adapter admission remain pending.
